method.winBonus: 2 points added for each team win across every weekly award score; statewide multipliers are applied after the bonus
method.playerOfGame: One current unweighted overall winner per completed game. Full reported game statistics are preferred; named touchdown totals from scoring plays are the fallback. When no player name is reported, the winning team receives a clearly labeled unnamed scoring-leader placeholder until details arrive. Selections update whenever new stats arrive.
method.locking: Each week remains provisional through Wednesday and locks at the start of the following Thursday in America/Denver time.
